estimates.assumptions: 500g dry macaroni (standard elbow or similar); ~74g carbs and 3g fiber per 100g uncooked
2 US cups (480ml) chicken stock; assumes standard low-sodium broth ~1g carbs per cup
1/2 US cup (120ml) heavy cream; ~3.3g carbs per 100ml, scaled to volume
1 standard fajita seasoning packet (~30-35g); typical commercial mix values
3 medium diced chicken breasts ~450g raw boneless skinless total; zero carbs
1 small onion (~70g) finely diced; raw values
2 medium red bell peppers (~240g total) finely diced; raw values
1 cup (100g) shredded cheddar cheese; standard values
small handful chopped parsley for garnish (~10g); raw values
